task_language: put the middle black bowl on the plate

subtasks.name: pick(middle_black_bowl)
subtasks.outcome: never attempted: the middle (image-left) bowl is never approached

subtasks.name: place(middle_black_bowl, plate, on)
subtasks.outcome: never attempted; the plate itself is grasped and held tilted on edge from step 120 to the end

behaviour_summary: pi0 descends between the back bowl and the plate, closes on the plate's back rim (~80-100), and lifts the plate onto its edge, holding it tilted for the rest of the episode while pushing the back bowl aside.
runs_trained_task: libero_spatial 'pick up the black bowl ... and place it on the plate' (mis-targeted at the plate/back bowl); low confidence

failures.mode_definition: pi0 descends on and grasps an object other than the instructed target (a distractor or the destination itself) when the target is identified by a referring expression.
failures.hl_remedy: HALT -> VERIFY(plate flat on the table; if not, ESCALATE) -> RETREAT(up 10 cm) -> REPROMPT 'pick up the middle black bowl and place it on the plate' -> WATCH 3 s that the gripper moves toward the middle bowl -> VERIFY(bowl in gripper); retry once, then ESCALATE
failures.prevention: Before the first descent, VERIFY that the gripper is above the referred object (middle bowl); HALT if the descent target is the destination.
failures.observation: Step 60: gripper over the gap between the back bowl and the plate. Step 80: fingers come down on the plate's back rim. Steps 100-120: plate lifted and tilting. Step 140: plate standing on edge, back bowl pushed to the image right. 140-409: plate held tilted; around 280 it leans against the front bowl. The image-left (middle) bowl is never approached.

notes: It is unclear whether pi0 meant to grasp the back bowl and slipped onto the plate rim (which would be a low-level misalignment on a still-wrong object) or targeted the plate. Either way the middle bowl was never chosen. 'Middle' is taken as the bowl at middle depth (image-left).
